title: CmdPal: Honor the PowerToys language setting

status.label: Product direction blocks final validation
status.detail: No upstream head, discussion, or architecture decision changed. The fork remains Copilot-clean with zero published findings and zero unresolved threads, but out-of-process providers may construct localized objects before receiving the host language. A rebuild was not started because resolving that concern depends on whether Command Palette should honor the PowerToys language setting at all.

next_action: Obtain the CmdPal language-boundary decision. If the change should proceed, design extension-process language initialization before localized provider construction, rebuild the exact candidate, and draft the current-head review action.

phase0.detail: A collaborator stated that Command Palette is intentionally disconnected from PowerToys settings; the author asked whether Windows display language should remain authoritative and offered to close the PR.

fork_head.details: The affected common library and unit-test dependency chain built with Visual Studio MSBuild after clearing inherited GIT_CONFIG_* variables. All three AppLanguageHelper tests passed. The earlier targeted extension, toolkit, common, view-model, UI, and unit-test projects also passed on the preceding fork head; a full module-chain build was not rerun.

upstream_safety.detail: No public mutation was made to microsoft/PowerToys.
